verdict.rationale: Qodo runs autonomously in the background on pull requests. Once connected, it automatically reviews every PR, can be set to trigger reviews automatically, and auto-publishes risk labels. Its governance docs describe standards enforced "automatically… without manual intervention." These automations are fixed to PR review, though; the evidence shows no general-purpose way to set up your own. missing for 10: user-defined automation workflows (custom triggers, schedules, or event-driven tasks beyond PR review), background agents acting on arbitrary tasks, independent/hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
